Sample Taxon Reports
```{r}
# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(path = "/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/experiment_all/sample_taxon_reports", pattern = ".*.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
seq_metrics = read.csv("/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/sequencing_summary_metrics_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Process all CSV files and combine them
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(csv_files, process_csv_file))

# separate slurry from pond samples
pond_samples = c("s9","s10","s19","s20")

# Create sample metadata using helper function
sample_metadata = create_sample_metadata(seq_metrics, pond_samples) %>%
  select(sample_name, base_sample, library_prep, experiment, water_control, infection_class, sample_type)

# Merge the taxonomy data with metadata
merged_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample_name")

# Filter to include only species level (tax_level == 1) to avoid duplication
all_data_species <- merged_data %>%
  filter(tax_level == 1) %>% 
  filter(water_control == "No") %>% 
  filter(infection_class != "Definite") # filter out positive controls

# Recode values for publication
all_data_species = all_data_species %>% 
  mutate(
    sample_type = recode(sample_type, `environmental` = "wastewater"),
    library_prep = recode(library_prep, `NGS` = "mNGS")
  ) 
```

Positive Inclusion Criteria
```{r}
species_data_filtered = all_data_species %>% 
  filter(nt_rpm >= 1 | nr_rpm >= 1 | nt_count >=3) %>% # positive inclusion criteria
  filter(nt_alignment_length > 50)
```

Taxonomic Composition
```{r}
# Create a taxa table
taxa_table <- species_data_filtered %>%
  select(tax_id, tax_level, name, genus_tax_id, category, library_prep, nt_rpm, nt_count, base_sample, sample_type) %>%
  distinct() %>%  # only unique taxa
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%   # filter out species with no aligned category
  filter(category %in% c("archaea","bacteria","eukaryota","viruses")) # because some blank categories are not NA

phylum_composition_overall <- taxa_table %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarize(total_abundance = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance) * 100)

# Compare library prep at different taxonomic levels (e.g., phylum level)
phylum_composition <- taxa_table %>%
  group_by(category, library_prep, sample_type) %>%
  summarize(total_abundance = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(library_prep, sample_type) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance) * 100)


```

Diversity

```{r, results='asis'}
cat("\\captionsetup{labelformat=empty}")

# Function to compute diversity comparison table
compute_diversity_results <- function(df) {
  species_agg <- df %>%
    group_by(sample_name, tax_id) %>%
    summarise(nt_count = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  abundance_matrix <- species_agg %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample_name, values_from = nt_count, values_fill = 0)

  abund_mat <- as.matrix(abundance_matrix[,-1])
  rownames(abund_mat) <- abundance_matrix$tax_id

  diversity_tbl <- data.frame(
    sample_name = colnames(abund_mat),
    Shannon = apply(abund_mat, 2, vegan::diversity, index = "shannon"),
    Simpson = apply(abund_mat, 2, vegan::diversity, index = "simpson"),
    Richness = apply(abund_mat, 2, function(x) sum(x > 0))
  ) %>%
    left_join(df %>% 
                select(sample_name, library_prep, base_sample, sample_type) %>% 
                distinct(),
              by = "sample_name")
  
  diversity_tbl <- diversity_tbl %>%
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    Shannon = mean(Shannon),
    Simpson = mean(Simpson),
    Richness = mean(Richness),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
  diversity_paired = diversity_tbl %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = base_sample,
      names_from = library_prep,
      values_from = c(Shannon, Simpson, Richness)
    )

    metrics <- c("Shannon", "Simpson", "Richness")
         
  results <- lapply(metrics, function(metric) {
    ngs <- diversity_paired[[paste0(metric, "_NGS")]]
    msspe <- diversity_paired[[paste0(metric, "_MSSPE")]]

    test <- wilcox.test(ngs, msspe, paired = TRUE)

    data.frame(
      metric = metric,
      NGS = mean(ngs, na.rm = TRUE),
      MSSPE = mean(msspe, na.rm = TRUE),
      `p-value` = test$p.value
    )
  })

  bind_rows(results)
}

# ---- Create three datasets ----
species_slurry <- species_data_filtered %>% filter(sample_type == "slurry")
species_env <- species_data_filtered %>% filter(sample_type == "environmental")

# ---- Compute results ----
tbl_overall <- compute_diversity_results(species_data_filtered) %>% mutate(Type = "Overall")
tbl_slurry  <- compute_diversity_results(species_slurry) %>% mutate(Type = "Slurry")
tbl_env     <- compute_diversity_results(species_env) %>% mutate(Type = "Wastewater")

# ---- Combine ----
results_all <- bind_rows(tbl_slurry, tbl_env, tbl_overall) %>%
  rename("Diversity Measure" = metric)

# ---- Final kable ----
results_all_kbl = results_all %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "Comparison of diversity metrics between library preparation methods by sample type",
    digits = 2,
    align = "lrrr",   # adjust as needed: text left, numbers right
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), # polished journal look
    position = "center",
    full_width = TRUE,
    font_size = 9
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%  # strong header
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major") # if repeating target names
```

```{r}
# 1. Aggregate counts per tax_id per sample
species_agg <- species_data_filtered %>%
  group_by(sample_name, tax_id) %>%
  summarise(nt_count = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 2. Create abundance matrix (taxa x samples)
abundance_matrix <- species_agg %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_name, 
    values_from = nt_count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Convert to numeric matrix and set rownames
abund_mat <- as.matrix(abundance_matrix[,-1])
rownames(abund_mat) <- abundance_matrix$tax_id

# 3. Compute diversity metrics per sample
diversity_tbl <- data.frame(
  sample_name = colnames(abund_mat),
  Shannon = apply(abund_mat, 2, vegan::diversity, index = "shannon"),
  Simpson = apply(abund_mat, 2, vegan::diversity, index = "simpson"),
  Richness = apply(abund_mat, 2, function(x) sum(x > 0))
)

# 4. Add library prep info
diversity_tbl <- diversity_tbl %>%
  left_join(species_data_filtered %>% 
              select(sample_name, library_prep, base_sample, sample_type) %>% 
              distinct(), by = "sample_name")

# Compare alpha diversity between library prep methods
shannon_libprep_plot = ggplot(diversity_tbl, aes(x = library_prep, y = Shannon, color = library_prep)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "viridis", direction = -1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "a",
       x = "", 
       y = "Shannon Diversity Index") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

simpson_libprep_plot = ggplot(diversity_tbl, aes(x = library_prep, y = Simpson, color = library_prep)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "viridis", direction = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "b",
       x = "", 
       y = "Simpson Diversity Index") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

rich_libprep_plot = ggplot(diversity_tbl, aes(x = library_prep, y = Richness, color = library_prep)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "mako", direction = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "c",
       x = "", 
       y = "Species Richness") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

horizontal_space <- plot_spacer()
combined_diversity_plots = (shannon_libprep_plot | horizontal_space | simpson_libprep_plot | horizontal_space | rich_libprep_plot)
  plot_layout(ncol = 5, widths = c(2, 0.2, 2, 0.2, 2))
  
combined_diversity_plots
```

```{r, results='asis'}
cat("\\captionsetup{labelformat=empty}")
# get table of only unique species
taxa_table_genus <- virus_data %>%
  select(tax_id, tax_level, name, genus_tax_id, genus_name, category, library_prep, nt_rpm, nt_count, base_sample, sample_type) %>%
  distinct() %>%  # only unique taxa
  filter(!is.na(genus_name))  # filter out species with no aligned category

# Calculate viral relative abundance of each viral genus (among all viruses)
genus_composition <- taxa_table_genus %>%
  #group_by(genus_name, library_prep) %>%
  group_by(genus_name) %>% 
  summarize(total_abundance = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  #group_by(library_prep) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance) * 100)

# Calculate mean nt_rpm for each taxon across samples
genus_summary <- virus_data %>%
  group_by(genus_name, library_prep) %>%
  filter(!genus_name %in% c("Alphapapillomavirus","Nicoomyvirus","Myrnavirus")) %>% # filter out known phages
  filter(genus_tax_id != -200) %>% 
  summarize(mean_nt_rpm = mean(nt_rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_reads = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  na.omit() %>% 
  arrange(desc(mean_nt_rpm))

# Select top 10 genus names by mean nt_rpm
top_genus_names <- genus_summary %>%
  group_by(genus_name, library_prep) %>%
  summarize(mean_rpm = mean_nt_rpm, .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_rpm)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(genus_name)

# Filter data for top taxa
top_genus_data <- virus_data %>%
  filter(genus_name %in% top_genus_names)
  #na.omit()

# Create overall table with Top Viral Genera
top_genus_summary = top_genus_data %>% 
  drop_na(genus_name) %>% 
  group_by(genus_name) %>% 
  summarise(mean_rpm = mean(nt_rpm), .groups = "drop")
  #slice_head(n=20)

# get frequency of each genus
genus_counts <- virus_data %>%
  drop_na(genus_name) %>% 
  count(genus_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(genus_name = fct_reorder(genus_name, n))

# get proportion of time genus is detected in each sample
virus_sample_per = virus_data %>% 
  drop_na(genus_name) %>% 
  group_by(genus_name) %>% 
  summarize(
    perc_of_samples = n_distinct(sample_name) / n_distinct(.$sample_name)
    ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(perc_of_samples))

# join back to overall table
top_genus_summary = top_genus_summary %>% 
  left_join(genus_counts, by = "genus_name") %>% 
  left_join(virus_sample_per, by = "genus_name") %>% 
  left_join(genus_composition, by = "genus_name") %>% 
  arrange(desc(perc_of_samples))

top_genus_summary_kbl = top_genus_summary %>%
  rename(
    "Genus" = genus_name,
    "rPM" = mean_rpm,
    "Species detections" = n,
    "Percent of Samples" = perc_of_samples,
    "Relative Abundance*" = relative_abundance
  ) %>% 
  select(-total_abundance) %>% 
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "Most abundant genera across all samples",
    digits = 2,
    align = "lrrr",   # adjust as needed: text left, numbers right
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), # polished journal look
    position = "center",
    full_width = TRUE,
    font_size = 9
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%  # strong header
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major") # if repeating target names

top_genus_summary
```

```{r}
genus_composition_heat <- viral_genera %>%
  mutate(
    viral_target = str_detect(name_group, regex(paste0("\b(", paste(name_targets, collapse = "|"), ")\b"), ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) %>% 
  filter(nt_rpm > 1) %>% 
  group_by(sample_type, library_prep, genus_name) %>%
  summarize(total_abundance = sum(nt_rpm), .groups="drop") %>%
  group_by(sample_type, library_prep) %>%
  mutate(relative_abundance = total_abundance / sum(total_abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(lp = paste(library_prep, sample_type, sep="-")) %>%
  select(genus_name, lp, relative_abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = lp, values_from = relative_abundance, values_fill = 0)

heat_mat <- genus_composition_heat %>%
  column_to_rownames("genus_name") %>%
  as.matrix()

perc_vec <- viral_genera %>%
  distinct(genus_name, perc_of_samples) %>%
  filter(genus_name %in% rownames(heat_mat)) %>%
  slice(match(rownames(heat_mat), genus_name)) %>%
  pull(perc_of_samples)

# order by percentage of samples
ord <- order(perc_vec, decreasing = FALSE)
heat_mat <- heat_mat[ord, , drop = FALSE]
perc_vec <- perc_vec[ord]

png("/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/microbial_community/figures/superheat.png", height = 1200, width = 1050)
superheat(
  heat_mat,
  row.title = "Viral Genus",
  #pretty.order.rows = TRUE,
  pretty.order.cols = TRUE,
  legend.height = 0.3,
  legend.width = 3.5,
  legend.text.size = 14,
  yr = perc_vec,
  yr.plot.type = "bar",
  yr.axis.name = "% samples where genus detected",
  yr.bar.col = "grey40",
  heat.lim = c(0.00001,100)
  )
dev.off()


subset_ww_m <- heat_mat[heat_mat[ , "MSSPE-wastewater"] > 0.0001, ]
nrow(subset_ww_m)

subset_ww <- heat_mat[heat_mat[ , "mNGS-wastewater"] > 0.0001, ]
nrow(subset_ww)

subset_s_m <- heat_mat[heat_mat[ , "MSSPE-slurry"] > 0.0001, ]
nrow(subset_s_m)

subset_s <- heat_mat[heat_mat[ , "mNGS-slurry"] > 0.0001, ]
nrow(subset_s)
```

```{r}
  "Sapelovirus",

ghost_data_filtered = ghost_data %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(name, paste(c("Alphapapillomavirus","Parvovirus"), collapse = "|"))) %>% 
  mutate(
    is_dna = str_detect(
      name,
      regex(paste(dna_virs, collapse = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE)
    ),
    is_rna = str_detect(
      name,
      regex(paste(rna_virs, collapse = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(name, is_dna, is_rna)

# get % of livestock or human hosts
dim(table(ghost_data_filtered$name)) / dim(table(virus_data$name))
```

```{r}
# Load required library
library(stringr)

# Set your folder path
folder_path <- "/Users/mattparker/.Trash/illumina/Run1/RR226_1" 

# Get all fastq.gz files
files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.fastq\\.gz$", full.names = FALSE)

print(paste("Found", length(files), "FASTQ files"))

# Extract sample names and read type (R1/R2)
# Pattern: everything before _R1_ or _R2_
file_info <- data.frame(
  file_name = files,
  sample_name = str_replace(files, "_R[12]_001\\.fastq\\.gz$", ""),  # Remove _R1/R2 and extension
  read_type = str_extract(files, "R[12]")  # Extract R1 or R2
)

# Pivot to wide format with R1 and R2 columns
fastq_table <- file_info %>%
  select(sample_name, read_type, file_name) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = read_type,
    values_from = file_name,
    names_prefix = ""
  )

# Display the result
print(fastq_table)

# Example: Join with another table
# Assuming you have another table like this:
other_table <- read.csv("/Users/mattparker/downloads/file_names_sra.csv")

# Perform the join
final_table <- left_join(other_table, fastq_table, by = "sample_name")

# Or if you want the other table first:
# final_table <- left_join(other_table, fastq_table, by = "sample")

print(final_table)

# Optional: Export to CSV
write.csv(final_table, "/Users/mattparker/downloads/fastq_file_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
